description: List the workspace's Brain documents (brand guidelines, reports, style guides and similar files), newest first, with title, type, size and text-extraction status. Filter by document_type or status. Text is not included: use aidelly_get_brain_document to read it. The Brain also indexes each document for aidelly_search_brain. Read-only.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_brain_documents
title: List Brain Documents
